view: AP-type frontal (recorded PA; scapulae overlap lung fields, monitoring leads on)
technical_quality: Adequate penetration and inspiration; mild rotation; multiple ECG electrodes and lead wires overlie both hemithoraces and partly obscure the left lung; no L/R marker visible, conventional orientation assumed.

left upper anterior chest (patient left, upper zone)

abnormalities.finding: Branching, streaky lucencies within the soft tissues of the lateral chest wall / flank, consistent with subcutaneous emphysema (small volume, ~4-5 cm)
Lucent band paralleling the left mediastinal/paraspinal border - possible pneumomediastinum, uncertain (could be normal lung interposition)
Lungs mildly hyperlucent (left upper zone more than right) without definite bulla, pleural line or pneumothorax; no consolidation or effusion

description_zh: 胸部正面片（疑為AP攝影），雙側可見多枚心電圖電極及多條外接導線重疊於胸廓及左側腹壁，左上肺野另有兩段細直線狀導線投影。左側下外側胸壁／側腹軟組織內可見分支狀條紋透亮影，疑為少量皮下氣腫（約4-5公分）；左側縱膈旁另見一條透亮帶，無法排除縱膈氣腫，建議側位片或CT進一步評估。雙肺透亮度略高（左上肺野較明顯），但未見明確肺大泡、臟層肋膜線或氣胸，無實質化或肋膜積液；心臟縱膈輪廓大致正常，未見胸管或引流管。
